# Original runtime dependencies

Local copies of the exact versions referenced by the supplied support.js:

- React 18.3.1: https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js (MIT)
- ReactDOM 18.3.1: https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js (MIT)
- Babel standalone 7.29.0: https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.29.0/babel.min.js (MIT; bundled dependency notices retained)

Original distribution license comments are preserved. These are the supplied template runtime, not the host application's React bundle. support.js loads the files from this directory so startup does not depend on a CDN.
